question_stem:
A neutron within a nucleus decays to produce a proton, a β⁻ particle and an (electron) antineutrino.
n → p + β⁻ + ν̄

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Use the quark composition of the neutron to show that the neutron has no charge.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Complete Fig. 8.1 by giving appropriate values of the charge and the mass of the proton, the $\beta^-$ particle and the antineutrino.
